author: Fextralife
description:
Crimson Desert Review - GAME OF THE YEAR - OR NOT?
In this Crimson Desert review, we'll be taking an in-depth look at what one of the most anticipated titles of the year. Developed by Pearl Abyss, the team behind the massive MMO Black Desert. This title has been under the microscope since its reveal. Throughout the years, we're seen flashy trailers, the unique combat, and the promises of a living breathing world. 
Now that Crimson Desert is finally here, we have to have the $70 questions. Is Crimson Desert the next evolution of the open world genre? Or is it another case of style over substance? In this video, we'll be looking into aspects of the game such as the story and setting, gameplay mechanics, audio visual and performance, and whether the sheer amount of padding in this world makes it worth your time.
